from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets import get_asset_ranking_engine
from src.runtime.assets.schema import AssetDescriptor
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Asset_Rank(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_asset_rank"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("valid_assets_json", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("scene_intent_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("scene_plan_json",   "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("zone",              "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("category",          "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("top_k",             "int",    widget_type="int",  default=10)
        self.add_output("recommendations_json", "string")
        self.add_output("ranked_count",         "int")
        self.add_output("top_asset_name",       "string")
        self.add_output("top_score",            "float")
        self.add_output("ranking_ok",           "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        assets_json  = inputs.get("valid_assets_json", "") or ""
        intent_json  = inputs.get("scene_intent_json", "") or ""
        plan_json    = inputs.get("scene_plan_json", "") or ""
        zone         = str(inputs.get("zone") or "")
        category     = str(inputs.get("category") or "")
        top_k        = int(inputs.get("top_k") or 10)

        assets = []
        try:
            raw = json.loads(assets_json) if assets_json.strip() else []
            items = raw if isinstance(raw, list) else []
            assets = [AssetDescriptor.from_dict(d) for d in items if isinstance(d, dict)]
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Failed to parse valid_assets_json: {exc}")
            return {"recommendations_json": "[]", "ranked_count": 0,
                    "top_asset_name": "", "top_score": 0.0,
                    "ranking_ok": False, "exec_out": True}

        if not assets:
            self.log_error("No assets to rank.")
            return {"recommendations_json": "[]", "ranked_count": 0,
                    "top_asset_name": "", "top_score": 0.0,
                    "ranking_ok": False, "exec_out": True}

        intent = None
        if intent_json.strip():
            try:
                intent = json.loads(intent_json)
            except Exception:
                pass

        plan = None
        if plan_json.strip():
            try:
                plan = json.loads(plan_json)
            except Exception:
                pass

        try:
            result = get_asset_ranking_engine().rank(
                assets, intent=intent, plan=plan,
                zone=zone, category=category, top_k=top_k
            )
            top_name  = result.recommendations[0].asset.name if result.recommendations and result.recommendations[0].asset else ""
            top_score = result.recommendations[0].score if result.recommendations else 0.0
            self.log_info(f"Ranking: {result.ranked_count} recommendations, top={top_name!r} score={top_score:.3f}")
            return {
                "recommendations_json": json.dumps([r.to_dict() for r in result.recommendations], default=str),
                "ranked_count":         result.ranked_count,
                "top_asset_name":       top_name,
                "top_score":            top_score,
                "ranking_ok":           result.ok,
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Asset ranking failed: {exc}")
            return {"recommendations_json": "[]", "ranked_count": 0,
                    "top_asset_name": "", "top_score": 0.0,
                    "ranking_ok": False, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Asset_Rank
